description: E3: a lead only (the next packages build what lies behind it). After the Hollow Titan's fall Brann shows the giant the link in the oath-knot that is not like the others: a link of the first titan's own chain, cut, that the last king carried out from under the mountains. The oath that held the shell was the last lock; it is broken, and the ground under the Sundered Horns has begun to groan. The lead is heard and noted in the journal (lead.worldbreaker.heard); nothing of the Worldbreaker is built.

stages.objective: Heard: the last lock is broken, and the ground under the Sundered Horns groans
stages.waiting_text: A cut link of the first titan's chain is all there is yet - and the groaning under the Horns.
